title: Meta SMP
body:
Welcome to our Economy Survival Server — where survival meets opportunity! 💰
Start with nothing and build your way to the top in a thriving, player-driven economy. Mine valuable resources, farm crops, trade with other players, and create your own shops to grow your fortune. Whether you want to become the richest trader, a legendary builder, or an unstoppable explorer, the path is yours to choose.

💰 Earn money through trading and selling items
🛒 Run your own player shop and dominate the market
⚒️ Enjoy classic survival with an economy twist
🌍 Join a growing community of players
